test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech. **

She asked me what my favourite cuisine was.

options.text: She said to me, "What is your favourite cuisine?"
She said to me, "What my favourite cuisine is?"
She said to me, "What is my favourite cuisine?"
She said to me, "What your favourite cuisine was?"

solution:
The correct answer is** She said to me, "What is your favourite cuisine?"**

• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Direct Speech.
